metadata.title: The Taub-NUT Metric Is Not Projectively Induced
metadata.abstract: LeBrun's Kähler realization $g_m$ of the Taub--NUT metric on $\mathbb{C}^2$ is complete, Ricci-flat and not flat. Loi, Zedda and Zuddas proved that no multiple $\alpha g_m$ admits a Kähler immersion into a finite- or infinite-dimensional complex projective space when $m>\alpha/2$, and conjectured that the same holds for every $m>0$. We prove the conjecture. The restriction of the Kähler potential to the axis $z_2=0$ is governed by the Lambert $W$ function, so $\exp(\alpha\Phi_m)$ has a finite radius of convergence as a power series in $|z_1|^2$ although it is real analytic on the whole half-line; the Vivanti--Pringsheim theorem forbids nonnegative Taylor coefficients, and Calabi's criterion fails. We state the mechanism, which Arezzo, Loi, Placini and Zedda recently used for radial metrics, as a general obstruction to Kähler immersions. In statistical terms the axis restriction of $g_m$ would be a natural exponential family with mean domain $(0,\infty)$ and variance function $\mu/(1+2m\mu)$; the argument gives an elementary proof of the known fact, due to Bar-Lev, Bshouty and Enis, that no such family exists with variance function $\mu/(1+c\mu)$ for any $c>0$. The result confirms onemore case of the conjecture of Loi, Salis and Zuddas that Ricci-flat projectively induced Kähler metrics are flat. The analytic core of the proof has been machine-checked in Lean~4.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 作者宣称证明所有正参数 Taub–NUT 度量的任意倍数都不能 Kähler 浸入有限或无限维复射影空间，从而完成此前参数范围之外的猜想。
analysis.breakthrough: 利用轴上势函数的有限收敛半径与实解析延拓，阻断非负 Taylor 系数条件。
analysis.limitations: 机器检验覆盖摘要所称解析核心，不等于已独立检查全部几何推论；Lean 使用本身不代表 AI 披露。 本条依据官方摘要与评论整理，尚未核验正文证明；AI 披露以独立核查记录为准。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露使用 Claude Code 和 Codex 进行探索讨论、思想检验与完善、文献组织、代码与 Lean 形式化开发验证、数学纠错及编辑修改。

analysis.priorityReason: 以较初等解析障碍解决重要特殊度量的射影诱导问题。
